purpose: Source evidence for visual acceptance; not a production stylesheet or a claim of computed browser values.
method: Read directly from ZIP. HTML treated as text; theme.extend isolated after its literal extend key and decoded with JSONDecoder.raw_decode; PNG dimensions from IHDR; icon names and classes from HTMLParser. No HTML scripts or remote assets executed. SHA-256 comparison against ZIP entries.
interpretationRules: themeExtend values are literal declarations, not proof each token is used.
Utility classes are preserved verbatim; resolve effective cascade and font metrics in a trusted offline reference renderer.
Inline styles can be unused. Today declares handwriting and journal ruling but no body element uses font-handwriting or journal-ruled-canvas.
PNG dimensions are image pixels; device scale, screenshot cropping and rendering viewport are not recorded.
Record screenshot/code conflicts in reference-contract.md instead of silently converting them into a requirement.
